report:
Freshly assessed the current captured claim, four ordinary implementation entries (compile/mod.rs, annotations.rs, observe.rs, source.rs), and complete three-test set. There are no deferred or inapplicable entries. No source changes were necessary in this refresh.

The single observations Option<Expect> and its duplicate-field guard in CompileTest establish the shared snapshot; prepare requires observation markers and that expectation to agree, and run compares the observations field independently from diagnostics and queries. Annotation parsing gives each ty/sym marker a kind and source target, including stacked comments. collect makes a BTreeSet of file/line targets and determines requested kinds with any(), so duplicates cannot duplicate headers and source marker order cannot affect field order. Each selected source row emits exactly one header; the symbol branch precedes the type branch and each branch is conditional. A sym-only selection skips nonpath rows and never writes type fields. The same source-row stream serves both selectors: source::walk visits children before parents; typed correspondence preserves the source sequence and coercion rows; stable row sorting by file, end, reverse start and ordered target iteration apply the type-observation order rather than a separate symbol order. The captured starting_expressions claim defines that referenced ordering. Diagnostics and optional JSON query projection are constructed into separate Output fields, not appended to observations.

symbols_and_types_share_expression_headers includes repeated ty and sym markers and asserts exact output: one path header, symbol then type with two-space indentation, and a type-only call parent after its path child. This demonstrates grouping, duplicate idempotence, requested field filtering and shared postorder. reverse_marker_order_has_the_same_output asserts the identical complete snapshot for the opposite marker order. unresolved_paths_still_require_error_markers checks missing diagnostic accounting and then prepares a fixture with sym, ERROR and query capture; its exact symbol-only observation excludes type and diagnostic/query contamination, its diagnostic assertion establishes nonempty error output, and its independently parsed nonempty JSON query array establishes separate query output. Both latter outputs explicitly exclude the symbol observation field. These are concrete visible assertions, not reliance on test names or prior approvals.

This refresh executed only review start/read/record and source inspection; it did not execute tests or a build. Root is centrally running relevant test suites. The source and test-adequacy judgment above is independent of any prior passing run.
